chunks: For those who fear God there are pleasure gardens with their Lord.

key_terms.عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ: In the presence of their Lord

ai.seo_question: What is the reward promised to the God-fearing in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the intimate proximity (qurb) believers will enjoy with Allah in the afterlife, distinguishing the ultimate reward of the pious. It connects the ethical cultivation of taqwa with the spiritual reality of dwelling in the divine presence, a concept emphasized by scholars like Al-Tabarsi in his *Majma' al-Bayan* as the culmination of spiritual ascent.
